description: Use of garage as studio flat.
decision_conditions: Insufficient evidence has been provided by the applicant to show that the use has been in situ continuously for a period of 4 years prior to the submission of this application.The Local Planning Authority having due regard to its own evidence and assessing the submitted evidence considers that on the balance of probability, the evidence provided does not satisfactorily demonstrate that the garage of the property known as 267 Hedge Lane, N13 5DE has been used/and or occupied as a self-contained studio flat continuously for a period of more than four years from the date of submission of this application. Thus, the use would be UNLAWFUL.
